errors.text: The proposed Nb substitution is internally inconsistent because the stated Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr starting alloy contains no Nb.
No definite lighter-element substitution or alloy composition is specified, so the claimed density reduction cannot be calculated or experimentally reproduced.

The cited evidence only characterizes oxygen, porosity, and phases in powder-processed material; it does not support coherent B2 precipitation, HPT-induced ductility, the proposed composition window, or the mechanical-property targets.
The cited material has approximately 0.55 wt% oxygen, contradicting rather than supporting the proposed oxygen boundary of less than 0.2 wt%.
The hypothesis misses the key Cr-addition and reticulated Laves-phase strategy responsible for the target combination of strength and fracture strain.
